group_ask: ❓ Ask the admins of {title} privately — the button opens a private chat with Aegis.
group_anon: 🕶 Ask anonymously in {title}: the admins see the question without your name and may publish it.
blocked: You can't send anonymous questions here any more.
prompt: ❓ Write your question for the admins of {title} (up to {max} characters).
prompt_anon: 🕶 Write your anonymous question for {title} (up to {max} characters). Your name isn't shown to anyone.
too_long: Send a text of up to {max} characters.
sent: ✅ Sent to the admins of {title}. Their answer comes here.
sent_anon: ✅ Sent anonymously to the admins of {title}.
sent_none: ⚠️ Saved, but no admin of {title} can be reached privately right now — they'll see it in the panel.
done_b: 🚫 The sender is blocked (and stays unknown).
ap_none: You have nothing to appeal right now.

ap_sent_none: ⚠️ Saved, but no admin of {title} can be reached privately right now — they'll see it in the panel.

panel_intro: Members ask the admins privately (/ask) or anonymously (/anon). Anonymous questions are published only when an admin approves them.
panel_counts: 30 days: {total} questions · {open} open · {answered} answered · {published} published · {anon} anonymous
buttons_none: Both kinds of questions are off.
unblock_q: Let every blocked sender ask anonymous questions again?
